svg.aria-label: Tech stack by layer. Frontend: Angular, React, TypeScript, RxJS, Module Federation. Security and APIs: REST, Swagger, JWT, OAuth2. Backend: Java, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, .NET 8, C#, Python, Node.js. AI and LLM: LangChain, RAG, FAISS, Ollama, Amazon Bedrock. Data: PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, MongoDB. Test automation: Playwright, Selenium, BDD Gherkin, JUnit, Mockito, Jest, pytest. DevOps and cloud: Docker, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, AWS Lambda, AWS S3.
